reasons.label: No cash right now
reasons.fix: Pay by UPI at the door
reasons.if_fix_fails: Parcel goes to the hub shelf (P2)

reasons.label: Changed mind / doesn't need it
reasons.fix: No fix at the door: send to hub shelf
reasons.if_fix_fails: Parcel goes to the hub shelf (P2)

reasons.label: Wrong size / not as expected
reasons.fix: Offer an exchange (refused unit goes to hub shelf)
reasons.if_fix_fails: Parcel goes to the hub shelf (P2)

reasons.label: Not home / not answering
reasons.fix: Leave with neighbour or partner kirana
reasons.if_fix_fails: Parcel goes to the hub shelf (P2)

reasons.label: Asks to come another day
reasons.fix: Book a new slot (one more attempt)
reasons.if_fix_fails: Parcel goes to the hub shelf (P2)

reasons.label: Can't find the address
reasons.fix: Customer drops map pin on WhatsApp, re-attempt
reasons.if_fix_fails: Parcel goes to the hub shelf (P2)

reasons.label: Customer says they never ordered
reasons.fix: No fix: send to hub shelf, flag account
reasons.share_source: DECK (published range 9%-9%); even split (ASSUMPTION until survey)
reasons.if_fix_fails: Parcel goes to the hub shelf (P2)

reasons.label: Could not attempt (our side)
reasons.success_source: INDUSTRY 40%-50% of failed deliveries recoverable (no survey yet)
reasons.if_fix_fails: Parcel goes to the hub shelf (P2)

note: Exchanges save the customer's order, but the refused unit still goes to the hub shelf.
